items.title: API gateway: bahut saari services ka ek front door
items.one_idea: An API gateway is the single entry point for clients in front of many services: it routes each request to the right service, can combine several service calls into one response, and handles shared edge jobs (authentication, throttling, logging) once; the price is one more moving part and one more network hop.
items.spoken_hook: Gateway पाँच calls को एक call बना देता है।
items.hook_formula: surprising_fact: composition, five client calls become one (the five is an EXAMPLE)
items.cover_headline: One Front Door For Many Services
